data.long_meaning: She who is always present in the moment and embodies the essence of life, like a beautiful flower in full bloom under the moonlight. Parents who choose Qaisa usually hope their child will grow to embody living in the moment and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the concept of being fully present in the moment resonates deeply with the spiritual practices of mindfulness and living in the now.
